title: GeoForge PlantUML options
description: Describes the PlantUML diagrams generated from the model '<model>.geoforge' by the file '<model>.puml-options.json'. One '<model>.<name>.puml' is written per diagram.

diagrams.description: The diagrams to generate from the model.

name.description: Names the diagram: it is written to '<model>.<name>.puml'. Defaults to 'diagram<n>'.

title.description: Diagram title. Defaults to the model's name.

patterns.description: A regular expression, or a list of them of which any may match.

selection.description: Which types become classes in the diagram. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, matched unanchored (use ^ and $ to anchor). Applied in order: (1) the 'include*' options (all must match; with none, every type -- or none if only 'include-related' is given); (2) the 'exclude*' options remove matching types; (3) 'include-related' adds types (not subject to the excludes in 2); (4) 'exclude-related' removes types.

include-package.description: Include types whose package (qualified name without the type's own name, dotted) matches any of these.

exclude-package.description: Exclude types whose package matches any of these.

include.description: Include types whose qualified (dotted) or simple name matches any of these.

exclude.description: Exclude types whose qualified (dotted) or simple name matches any of these.

include-kind.description: Include types whose kind matches any of these: feature, datatype, codelist or builtin (e.g. 'feature|datatype'). Only feature and datatype types are drawn as classes.

exclude-kind.description: Exclude types whose kind matches any of these: feature, datatype, codelist or builtin.

include-related.description: Add the named types and the types related to them. Added after the excludes, so they are not affected by them.

exclude-related.description: Remove the named types and the types related to them. Applied last.

name.description: Pattern(s) selecting the starting types (matched against qualified or simple name). The starting types themselves are included (or excluded). If left out, the starting types are those selected by the include*/exclude* options, before any *-related is applied.

relations.description: Relations to follow, named like the keywords in the language. Default: all. 'extends': the supertype; 'parent', 'child', 'relation': the type of a property of that kind (a plain property of a feature type is a 'relation'). Only properties of feature types are followed; properties of datatypes, codelists and builtins are attributes.

direction.description: 'out' follows from the type (to its supertype, to the types of its properties); 'in' follows towards it (to its subtypes, to the types referring to it).

depth.description: Number of relation steps to follow from the starting types. -1 (the default) for unlimited.

diagramOptions.description: Show/hide of properties, by simple name (regular expressions) and kind. A property is shown if it matches all given 'show-*' options (none: all) and no 'hide-*' option. A hidden property is also left out as a relation.

show-property.description: Show only properties whose name matches any of these.

hide-property.description: Hide properties whose name matches any of these.

show-property-kind.description: Show only properties whose kind matches any of these: identity, geometry, parent, child or relation (e.g. 'parent|child'). A property without a keyword is a 'relation' if its type is a feature type, otherwise implicitly a 'child'.

hide-property-kind.description: Hide properties whose kind matches any of these: identity, geometry, parent, child or relation.

unselected-references.description: What to do with a property whose type is a feature type that is not selected: 'hide' it, or show it as a 'field' instead of as a relation.

show-property-type-kind.description: Show only properties whose type's kind matches any of these: feature, datatype, codelist or builtin. A property of a selected feature type is drawn as an arrow, one of any other type as a field, so 'feature' leaves only the arrows.

hide-property-type-kind.description: Hide properties whose type's kind matches any of these: feature, datatype, codelist or builtin. 'datatype|codelist|builtin' hides the fields and keeps the arrows.
